summary: Source delta (Learner.syncWithLeader NEWLEADER now starts the learner pipeline, enqueues and clears buffered proposals before the NEWLEADER ACK; startup split into startupWithoutServing/startServing) required a model change. The reference suite was rewritten for stream-driven sync, NEWLEADER/UPTODATE, ACK ordering, the INITIAL-state shutdown path, and implementation-faithful election/discovery. Update.tla adds focused, open (EnvUpdate) and discharge views. The prior harness was rebased with 13 update-local probes. 7 fresh traces (4 prior scenarios rerun, 3 update scenarios) replay through reference Actions with completion and full-consumption witnesses. Model checking found MC-1 CommittedQuorumDurable (NEWLEADER quorum commits DIFF entries learners have only enqueued; also violated on the replayed real trace), MC-2 NewLeaderAckFirst (proposal ACK consumed as NEWLEADER ACK), and MC-3 SyncCommitHasPendingProposal (NPE for a COMMIT after NEWLEADER). Code review added CR-4 (INITIAL learner shutdown leaks processors) and CR-5 (pre-Zab1.0 sync never starts the server). All five reproduced on the updated implementation. Old-tree controls: MC-1 also loses the committed txn (pre-existing, window narrowed but not closed); MC-2, MC-3, CR-4, CR-5 pass on old code (introduced by the update). All TLC runs are 30-minute budget-limited; no exhaustive pass is claimed. MC-1 and MC-2 reproductions use timing assistance; the CommittedAgreement data-loss consequence was not reached by model checking and is shown only by the implementation reproduction. CI verdict: FAIL.
